s2-neighbor.desc: an older woman in a cardigan

go-between-courier.desc: a figure in a delivery jacket

vanished.1.1.line: {s2-recipient} stands at the hub counter holding a paper receipt for door 4C.

vanished.1.2.line: {s2-recipient} points {family-caller-officer} to the hub screen above the counter.

vanished.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} reads the hub screen: "P-7731. Out for delivery 02:58. Door 4D."

vanished.1.4.line: {s2-hub-clerk} shrugs at {s2-recipient} across the counter and turns back to the till.

bot-log.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} scrolls back through the route records at the bot bay terminal.

bot-log.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} reads the route log on the terminal: "Stop, door 4D, 03:07, 40 seconds."

bot-log.1.3.line: {s2-hub-clerk} leaves the hub at closing with a taped box under one arm.

bot-log.1.4.line: Comm, one side: "Not now, Mama. I'm at work."

jacket-at-4c.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} waits outside tenement door 4C before dawn, hands empty.

jacket-at-4c.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at door 4C and waits, but nobody answers.

jacket-at-4c.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} walks off down the corridor with nothing in hand.

jacket-at-4c.1.4.line: {family-caller-officer} walks a patrol along the floor above, comm in hand.

late-handoff.1.1.line: Comm, one side, from inside the lift: "Put him on. Mama, put him on."

late-handoff.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} steps away from the meeting point and takes the lift down.

late-handoff.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} comes back to the meeting point twelve minutes later.

late-handoff.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the meeting point and says nothing about the time.

mama-s-neighbor.1.1.line: Comm, one side: "A box at 4D? She did not open it? Mama, slow down."

mama-s-neighbor.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} stands still in the lift hall, comm pressed to {family-caller-officer.his} ear.

mama-s-neighbor.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} holds up the hub screen photo of door 4D and taps it.

heavy-box.1.1.line: {s2-recipient} comes out of door 4C before dawn hugging a heavy closed crate.

heavy-box.1.2.line: {s2-recipient} shuffles the crate down the corridor toward the lift.

heavy-box.1.3.line: {s2-recipient} backs into the lift with the crate, and the doors close.

strip-on-the-rail.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} walks the bot bay rail slowly, crouching at each bracket.

strip-on-the-rail.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} picks a peeled label strip off the rail, printed "4417."

strip-on-the-rail.1.3.line: A weigh slip on the rail reads "3.4 kg" for a parcel listed as "kettle, 1.1 kg."

jacket-at-4d.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} waits outside tenement door 4D before dawn, hands empty.

jacket-at-4d.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at door 4D and waits, but nobody answers.

jacket-at-4d.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} leaves the corridor empty-handed and takes the lift down.

gift-receipt.1.1.line: {s2-hub-clerk} pulls a shop receipt from a coat pocket and hands it to {family-caller-officer}.

gift-receipt.1.2.line: The receipt reads "Kettle, gift wrapped, 21:40," from the night {s2-hub-clerk} left with the taped box.

tool-crate.1.1.line: {s2-recipient} opens the crate for {family-caller-officer}: wrenches, a drill, coils of cable.

tool-crate.1.2.line: {s2-recipient} points at a work ticket clipped inside the crate lid.

tool-crate.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} reads the work ticket aloud: "Shift start 05:15."

box-at-4d.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} knocks at door 4D and waits while slow steps come to the door.

box-at-4d.1.2.line: {s2-neighbor} hands {family-caller-officer} a sealed box from the shelf by {s2-neighbor.his} door.

box-at-4d.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} lifts the lid, then pries up a false bottom inside the box.

box-at-4d.1.4.line: A label under the false bottom reads "T-4417," the same digits as the peeled strip.

label-logged.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} carries the box up to the evidence desk at the station.

label-logged.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} hands the label to {desk-sergeant} across the evidence desk.

label-logged.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} sits down at the desk and fills in the evidence form.

door-4d-at-03-00.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} wait at the end of the fourth floor corridor before dawn.

door-4d-at-03-00.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} stops outside door 4D and looks along the corridor.

door-4d-at-03-00.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at door 4D and waits, but nobody answers.

door-4d-at-03-00.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} walks away from 4D empty-handed, toward the lift.

door-4d-at-03-00.1.5.line: Comm, one side, in a whisper: "Ten minutes, Mama. Ten minutes and I'm home."
